review_scope: Independent read-only resource and numerical interpretation of the completed R6 profile. This review does not admit, launch, grade, or approve a fit.

attempt_receipt.failure: worker exited with status 1 after the strict profile gate rejected incomplete/nonfinite gradient evidence

observed_updates.strict_failure_interpretation: The frozen strict profile predicate requires zero AMP-skipped updates and finite gradients. It correctly rejects a clean-gradient/throughput claim; it does not establish that the skipped nonfinite gradient was applied.

amp_safety_basis.frozen_code_path: GradScaler.unscale_(optimizer) -> record _found_inf_per_device flags -> optional GradStats and clipping -> GradScaler.step(optimizer) -> GradScaler.update()
amp_safety_basis.skip_accounting: The source counter increments attempts after unscale, counts any nonzero found-inf flag, and records completed updates as attempts minus skips. GradScaler.step is the existing optimizer guard; one detected overflow is skipped, then the scale is updated.
amp_safety_basis.qualification: This is evidence of one protected skipped step among 270 attempts, not evidence that all gradients were finite or that future skip frequency is negligible. No parameter/optimizer-state tensor snapshot from the profile independently proves the skip effect.

resources.resource_conclusion: No worker or parent memory/VRAM limit event was observed in this profile. The measured peaks leave headroom under the recorded caps; they do not guarantee every phase of a full epoch has identical peaks.

timing.qualification: The profile timing is a short measured-batch rate, not an end-to-end one-epoch measurement. No epoch duration is predicted by this review.

recommendation_conditions: A single original one-epoch fit may be considered for resource-only exploratory admission by the controller, under a new attempt ID and the existing source, crop, split, AMP scale, and recipe unchanged.
Do not call the R6 profile a clean numerical profile or a throughput-valid profile, and do not change AMP scale to force a zero-skip result.
Retain the existing run-level memory, runtime, source, split, crop, checkpoint, and provenance guards.

At terminal status, require successful fit completion, finite checkpoint tensors and optimizer/training-state tensors, and internally consistent attempt/completed/AMP-skip counts before any continuation, export, or promotion.

Report actual skip counts and scale behavior. Repeated or increasing skips, any nonfinite model/state tensor, or an unexplained count mismatch requires controller review before further training; this receipt does not impose a universal zero-skip threshold.
limitations: This review gives no accuracy, convergence, public-score, or submission claim.
The profile itself exited nonzero because the strict diagnostic gate was not satisfied; that failure is preserved.
The recommendation is resource-only and conditional on the controller's independent fit admission.
